name: cruise control of a car on a hill (PI controller)
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Astrom and Murray, Feedback Systems, 2nd ed. (Princeton, 2021), Eqs. (4.1)-(4.4) and Fig. 4.3; parameters of Section 4.1 (m = 1600 kg, Tm = 190 N m, wm = 420 rad/s, beta = 0.4, Cr = 0.01, rho = 1.3, Cd = 0.32, A = 2.4), kp = 0.5 and ki = 0.1 (Fig. 4.3)

assumptions: fourth gear, alpha_n = 12 (the gear of Fig. 4.3 is not stated; the linearizations use it)
speed positive, so sgn(v) = 1 in the rolling friction
throttle limited to [0, 1] as the source states, without anti-windup, written as a clip with abs
the hill as a step of the slope theta (the source ramps it over 1 s)

drift.v: (alpha_n*((abs((kp*(vr - v) + ki*z)) - abs((kp*(vr - v) + ki*z) - 1) + 1)/2)*Tm*(1 - beta*(alpha_n*v/wm - 1)**2) - m*g*Cr - 0.5*rho*Cd*A*abs(v)*v - m*g*sin(theta))/m
